label: Field mapping / child field (Search)
type: the leaf-level mapping for a single field within a type/object mapping, setting its data type and per-type options (including appliesToIndexType index-type:search-vector for vector fields, and search:synonym-source for text fields).
evidence: For a vector child field, enter the total number of elements in the vector embedding array. From Couchbase Server version 7.6.2 and later, Vector Search indexes can support arrays of scalars representing a vector.
relates_to_competency_question: What per-field options does a Search mapping expose, and do they differ for a vector field versus a text field?
